metadata.notes: Single-source machine ledger for future work and technical debt triage.

items.title: Improve jq-like query parser coverage
items.rationale: The current parser is intentionally small; richer operator support is needed for large planning corpora and less workaround logic.
items.goal: Replace the regex/token-split implementation with a proper query parser that validates supported jq-like operators strictly.
acceptanceCriteria: Preserve behavior for currently supported query operators.
Add support for nested array slicing and grouped filter expressions.
Emit actionable, classified errors for unsupported operator combinations.
Keep query failures single-attempt and explicit with recovery hints.
items.estimatedImpact: reduce plan-to-execution friction across repositories and reduce agent-level query retries
symptoms: Manual query rewrites for unsupported nested syntax.
Higher chance of workaround scripts that alter planner input.
nextActions: Implement parser module tests for edge cases.
Add operator coverage matrix to start and loop documentation.

items.title: Normalize agent identity resolution
items.rationale: Agent identity is currently derived from multiple env vars in multiple places, increasing inconsistency risk in parallel workflows.
items.goal: Use one canonical `KAN_AGENT_ID` source, with explicit fallback and clear recovery errors.
acceptanceCriteria: All agent-bound commands share one resolver helper.
CLI emits classified errors when identity cannot be resolved.
Telemetry includes resolver decision path for auditability.
items.estimatedImpact: improve claim/guard determinism across concurrent sessions
symptoms: Mixed environment assumptions across `agent claim`, `agent worktree`, and `agent guard`.
Conflicting claims created with implicit fallback mismatches.
nextActions: Add classified diagnostics with recommendation for `KAN_AGENT_ID`.

items.title: Add command-scope cache for config and plugin reads
items.rationale: Configuration and plugin state are reloaded multiple times in loop-like flows and repeated operations.
items.goal: Cache loaded runtime state for a single command invocation while preserving single-attempt failure behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: One execution context shared across loop stages when possible.
CI duration decreases in repeated stage scenarios.
items.estimatedImpact: faster execution and lower I/O for CI and automation runs
symptoms: Repeated config and plugin load calls in the same command sequence.
Unnecessary filesystem churn under compound execution.
nextActions: Profile before/after run times in representative repositories.

items.title: High-friction defaults in --skeleton root files
items.rationale: Skeleton initialization currently emits fixed root files in one opinionated structure.
items.goal: Decouple bootstrap seeds from hard-coded content and support repo-level policy overlays.
acceptanceCriteria: Template-driven bootstrap manifest for skeleton mode.
Zero required local edits for enterprise-specific policy defaults.
Migration path documented for existing repos.
items.estimatedImpact: reduce template drift and rerender churn across projects
symptoms: Strategy files must be manually updated after template evolution.
Non-uniform policy adaptation requires code edits.
items.mitigation: Move defaults to manifest-driven skeleton profile and keep this mode deterministic.
nextActions: Introduce manifest schema for skeleton profiles.
Add per-repo override path for policy seeds.

items.title: External command usage without adapter abstraction
items.rationale: Git and shell calls are inlined directly in command handlers, reducing testability and recovery consistency.
items.goal: Extract command execution into a narrow adapter interface used by all git/worktree flows.
acceptanceCriteria: Command execution has one reusable adapter with timeout and classified error wrapping.
Recovery recommendations include explicit next-step hints.
Existing behavior remains single-attempt and fail-fast.
items.estimatedImpact: harder-to-test command paths become deterministic and easier to reason about
symptoms: Mixed sync/throw branches around command outputs.
Uneven error contexts across git-related flows.
items.mitigation: Introduce `executeCommand` adapter and shared shell policy.
nextActions: Add a command runner boundary with typed result schema.
Route all command calls through boundary in one transaction.
